title: 1 Million Jumps in Minecraft
description:
An old video by MrJoned, reaching 1 million jumps. I'll copy and paste the original video description because I was hilarious. (also hi, it's me, from the future.)

On the Silver Springs server we track a lot of things with scoreboards. One of them is jumps, and I will be the first to 1 million jumps!

Yes, I do fly to stop Frosty from ruining my dream. 

Yes, I realize penguins can't fly.

No, I do not care.

Song is The Final Countdown by Europe.
